headline: KATSEYE to headline Edinburgh Summer Sessions 2027
sub: Their first-ever show in Scotland, on Aug 24, 2027
caption:
KATSEYE are heading to Scotland! The group will headline Edinburgh Summer Sessions on Aug 24, 2027.

It will be their first-ever performance in Scotland, at the Royal Highland Showgrounds. Presale opens Nov 26 at 5 PM UK time, followed by general sale on Nov 27. Past headliners of the festival include Chappell Roan, Lorde and The Cure.

📌 Source: Korea Herald, STV News
